{{Spoiler}}

'''Sweet berry toast''' is a secret meal of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|level|effect=Health Boost}} for {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|duration|effect=Health Boost}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw sweet berries, an egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or naan). The recipe is taught by a [[Cooking Recipe]] sold by a Novice [[Cook]], who also sells 8 sweet berry toast for 1 [[obol]].
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|heals}} and gives Health Boost {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|level|effect=Health Boost}} for {{Value|Sweet Berry Toast|duration|effect=Health Boost|format=clock}}. Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
